instruction: Make Georgia the default caption font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires making Georgia the default caption font in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify the Caption font name under DefaultFont settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the Caption font from LibreOffice Writer's registrymodifications.xcu file by parsing XML and finding the /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont/Caption property

Metric correctly handles the expected parameter - when expected.type='rule', the framework passes config['rules'] directly, so expected.get('caption_font') is the correct way to access the expected font name
Complete instruction coverage - the single requirement (set Georgia as default caption font) is fully verified by the evaluator
Expected value 'Georgia' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Proper edge case handling - getter handles missing files, XML parsing errors, and missing configuration by returning None; metric handles None results by returning 0.0
Correct data flow - getter returns font name string, metric receives and compares string against expected font name
